result:
Round 277 passes. A's test-only fix-up is correct, and the real browser behaves the way the new test assertions say. I found no bugs, and I didn't change any app source: the frozen-file check passed before and after my runs.

**Code checks**
- **Scope:** only the three files B allowed changed. `git status` shows the expected 12 lines.
- **Diffs:** A's test lines are identical to B's sketch. Doc 206 line 4 matches the task text exactly, and only the two allowed additions were made.
- **No lost assertions:** NS1 went from 1 to 4 assertions and still checks the old Split title once a clip is selected. NS6 and TC9 each went from 1 to 2.
- **B's checks script:** run with the original two tests put back, it gives exactly B's recorded output. On A's version the two sweeps still find 14 files and 6 hits, as B predicted.
- **Tests:** the three covering test files pass, 36/36.
- **Mutants:** N1 (the `aria-disabled` attribute removed) turns NS1, NS6 and TC9 red. N2 (the wrong Split title) turns only NS1 red.

**Browser checks** (fresh anonymous Chromium, 1440×900 and 1280×720)
- **Split:** with nothing selected it is marked unavailable, is not natively disabled, and its title says to select a clip or make a time selection first. A newly added clip is selected automatically, so Split is available right after Add. Clicking an empty lane makes it unavailable again; clicking the clip makes it available with the title "Split at the insert marker (Ctrl+E)".
- **Loop:** with no time selection it is unavailable and says "make a time selection first". After a drag on an empty lane it becomes available, and Ctrl+L turns the loop on. After clearing the selection with a click it stays available, with the title "Loop on / off (Ctrl+L)".
- **Undo:** I reached Undo with real Tab presses and pressed Enter until the history was empty, once after an Add and once after an Add plus a loop edit. Undo is then unavailable but not natively disabled, and focus moves to Redo with the brass focus ring visible.
- **Playback and export:** play and stop work and real audio comes out. The exported WAV is 16.000 s, 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo with no bad samples. Its hash is identical to round 276's, which is what you'd expect with no app change.
- **Premium access stays locked:** `/studio-lab` opens without sign-in and shows the demo badge. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. The access-token endpoint returns 401 with no sign-in and 500 with a fake token, and gives out no token either way.

The full test suite, build, `npm run verify` and the e2e smoke test are left to the root gate. Its result for round 277 isn't there yet.

**Info notes for B, not bugs**
- Doc 206 still says stage 2 is round 277 in two places (line 9 and the TODO at line 63). It is round 278 now, and those lines are outside A's grant, so they need to be granted in round 278. A reported this too.
- In my first run, one fresh page timed out after 150 s waiting for the demo to load, probably while the dev server was first compiling. The rerun passed, and every later page loaded normally.

My first Split run also failed once on a mistake in my own script: it expected Split to be unavailable right after Add. The rerun adds a deselect step and passes. Both runs are recorded in the report.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- c-round-277.md
- c-round-277.json
- c-round-277/ (screenshots, logs, scripts)
